instruction: Download and install the Papirus icon theme from gnome-look.org, then set it as the active icon theme for my GNOME desktop.

metadata.explanation: Variation 1: Changes from GTK theme to icon theme installation. Checks icon-theme setting instead of gtk-theme, looking for 'Papirus'. Similar difficulty and pattern to original. No custom functions needed as check_list metric is reused.

llm_judge_reasons: Evaluator correctly verifies the instruction's end goal: Papirus is set as the active icon theme
Postconfig uses correct command 'gsettings get org.gnome.desktop.interface icon-theme' to retrieve current icon theme setting
Getter (get_cache_file) correctly reads the gsettings output file
Metric (check_list) correctly uses regex pattern matching to find 'Papirus' in the output
Expected value 'Papirus' is semantically correct and will match the gsettings output format
Complete coverage: verifies the critical requirement (theme is set) rather than intermediate steps (download/install)
Logic flow is sound and will work correctly at runtime
